question: What is an advantage of NAS compared to SAN?
options: It functions in an existing IP environment.
theory: NAS's biggest practical advantage over SAN is that it rides on the IP/Ethernet network the organization already has, rather than requiring a dedicated Fibre Channel fabric with its own switches, HBAs, and cabling - this lets organizations add shared storage without the capital and operational cost of standing up a separate SAN infrastructure. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 10 - NAS Concepts)
